chunks: Your love for a thing blinds and deafens.

key_terms.لِلشَّيْءِ: For a thing or object of attachment
key_terms.وَيُصِمُّ: And it causes deafness, meaning inability to heed truth or criticism
key_terms.يُعْمِي: It causes blindness, meaning loss of clear perception

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean by saying love for something blinds and deafens?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that excessive attachment can impair a person's judgment and perception. When one is overly devoted to something, one may become unable to see its faults or hear criticism about it.
